promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Image 1: lens and white-electronics identity only; not layout
Image 2: Image 2: footprint, orientation and finish only; not design or colour

Image 1 is the identity reference only: the laser turret head this weapon family comes from, a glass lens dome inside red-trimmed white electronics. Take its lens, white ceramic panels and graphite parts as the language; do not copy its round turret outline. Image 2 is a footprint and finish reference only: an older heavy arm laser module, for scale, orientation and sprite density; do not copy its design or its olive colour.
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-source concept for one modular top-down tactical-game mech ARM weapon sprite
Primary request: the largest POINT-DEFENCE (PD) laser for a mech: a large bulky arm cannon where the electronics are built into the arm itself. A glass orb lens (clear glass sphere, deep blue interior) sits at the north tip in a smooth white sleeve; behind it a compact white rotary-style housing with a ribbed cooling jacket and paired white side pods carrying small indicator lights. A slight red motif only: red hazard chevrons on the side pods, a red lens collar ring and small red lights; the body stays white and light grey, the lens stays glass blue.
Critical perspective: strict 90-degree zenith orthographic top-down view of a weapon module, the camera looking straight down at its top surfaces, the weapon pointing toward the NORTH/TOP edge of the canvas. The glass orb lens at the north tip is a true sphere, so from above it reads as a round glass dome with a bright specular highlight and a deep blue interior; that round lens is expected and wanted. Everything else is flat top surfaces seen from directly above.
Style/medium: crisp high-resolution painted game sprite matching Image 2's finish: fine surface noise, panel seams, fasteners, restrained wear, upper-left baked object lighting. Futuristic clean white ceramic-composite electronics, light grey and graphite secondary parts, small cool indicator lights.
Composition/framing: exactly one isolated vertical module centred with generous padding on a flat featureless pure white isolation plate (no gradient, shadow, halo, floor, border or checkerboard). Symmetrical enough to mirror to either side, with a short rear mounting plate that disappears beneath a mech chassis. Bulky: about 1.9 to 2.2 times as long as it is wide.
Avoid: side view, perspective, isometric, multiple objects, hands, mech body, vehicle, turret base, olive-drab paint, rifle stock, text, logo, watermark, cropping.
